title: Stone Lock
description: Hard mod that kills way to achive iron
body:
![Stone Lock Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73554d6280e883a39b80620284166d1b139a8b2c_0.webp)
### What Does STONE LOCK Do?
**Stone Lock** - that mod that kills standart minecraft proggression by making **iron** not achievable.

Mod kills any appearance of iron in _*vanilla*_ **chests, pots, achealogy and even entities**, Also mod adds 2 new **achievements** to lead player to nether new way.

New way for achieving nether is making ...
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
crying obsidian out of **smooth basalt** that you can find in amethyst geode, **amethyst**, **gunpowder**, **glow ink sacs**

 Then using **glass bottles** to take of tears from obsidian.

 Then make **Nether fire divource** from copper, glass and from tears bottle
</details>

### Important!   
**For now this mod isnt compatable with any mod that adds new structures with loot!**   
**Mods like** [Teralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) **Can completely destroy stonelock idea of proggression.**
